title: Android app not correctly wrapping titles
summary: On a feed view, long article titles are not correctly wrapping and have an odd line break between parts of the title. The titles show as expected when clicking into an article.
body_markdown:
[rtreborb](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/rtreborb)


September 23, 2026, 1:23am 1


On a feed view, long article titles are not correctly wrapping and have an odd line break between parts of the title. The titles show as expected when clicking into an article.

I should fix it so it wraps similarly inside the article too. I just added that on the web as well.
